definitions.explanation: Indicating that a product was manufactured in China. Frequently seen on consumer goods sold in Japan.

examples.japanese: {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}のスマホ。
この{服|ふく}は{中国製|ちゅうごくせい}だが、{品質|ひんしつ}はいい。
examples.english: This clothing is made in China, but the quality is good.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}、{中国製|ちゅうごくせい}の{電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}が{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{普及|ふきゅう}している。
examples.english: In recent years, Chinese-made electric cars have been spreading around the world.

notes:
Compound of {中国|ちゅうごく} (China) + the suffix {製|せい} (made in/of). Parallel to {日本製|にほんせい}, {韓国製|かんこくせい}, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As a noun modifier: {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}の + noun
- As a predicate: {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}だ / です

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}の{家電|かでん}: Chinese-made appliances
- {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}の{部品|ぶひん}: Chinese-made parts
- {安|やす}い{中国製|ちゅうごくせい}: cheap Chinese-made (goods)
